_readme: Golden results from the four reference exports (prod, acc, stg, tst) with PROD as baseline. These were produced by Compare-PsoSysFiles.ps1 and verified against the Python reference. The sample XML files are NOT in this package (customer data) - Ish keeps them locally.
spotChecks: Parameters: AllowSplitTravel = True in PROD; (absent) in ACC, STG, TST
Parameters: CommitToAllocatedShift = False / True / False / True (PROD / ACC / STG / TST)
Parameters: SortValuePrecedenceMaximumStatus = 40 in PROD and STG; (absent) in ACC and TST
Parameters: ImplicitBreaksOnOffEventsRequired = True in PROD; (absent) ACC and STG; False in TST
Parameters: RoutingApiKey is shown as [API key set] everywhere; the actual key value is identical in every environment and must never appear in any output
Parameters: DEFAULT/ActivityBaseLabel in STG starts with a space; it must be shown with the visible whitespace marker U+2423
Groups: ST_Ops_Mgr (PROD, ACC) and ST_Ops_MGR (STG, TST) are ONE merged group (19 distinct groups across all four) and the spelling difference is flagged
Group Permissions: PROD has 341 rows, 241 of them explicit denies (allow=false). PROD ST_Dispatch / Administrator is allow=false, allow_edit=true -> displayed 'F / T'
Travel: ACC has 343 polygons and 1 travel-time weighting row (time zone America/Regina); PROD has 2 polygons; STG and TST have none
Table counts: Users rows = 147 / 262 / 99 / 129 (PROD / ACC / STG / TST) - shown in counts but never compared
Distinct parameter_ids across the four files = 41 and every one has a definition
mutationTests: Change TST latest version rows to 6.16.0.33 -> red banner, 'Same release (6.16), different patch builds', TST BEHIND
Change STG to a 6.15.x latest version -> red banner, 'Different RELEASES', STG BEHIND
6.13.0.9 must sort as OLDER than 6.13.0.67 (numeric version compare, never string compare)
Remove System_Version from one file -> warning, version unknown, no false green banner
Upload a file with an unknown parameter -> row shows '(no definition yet)' and appears in the missing-definitions template
Two uploads given the same name, no baseline selected, or two baselines selected -> blocked in the UI with a clear message
